source_title: MEDKids Immune System starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How immune cells help protect against infections
educational_content: The immune system helps protect the body from germs. White blood cells are germ fighters in the blood. White blood cells find germs and help get rid of them. The skin is a barrier that helps keep germs out. Vaccines teach the immune system to recognize germs. Washing hands helps stop germs from spreading.
learning_objectives: The immune system helps protect the body from germs.
Vaccines teach the immune system to recognize germs.
